name: xpk-decompress
description: Decompress Amiga XPK/NUKE and DUKE compressed files.

interface.shortDescription: Decompress Amiga XPK/NUKE and DUKE files.
interface.longDescription: Local skill and Python decompressor for unpacking Amiga XPK files that use the NUKE or DUKE sub-packers, with dry-run support and header/preview verification before writes.
defaultPrompt: Use xpk-decompress to unpack this Amiga XPK directory: <path>
